description: This file defines the NewDocumentActivity class for an Android application. It manages a user interface representing a 'document' in a document-centric app, handles activity lifecycle methods, and user interactions such as removing a document from the overview.

classes.name: NewDocumentActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that represents a 'document' in a document-centric application, providing UI and interaction logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the content view and initializing the document counter based on the intent.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles reuse of the activity when a new intent is received, updating the document counter display.

methods.name: onRemoveFromOverview
methods.description: Removes the document from the overview stack, effectively closing the document view.

methods.name: setDocumentCounterText
methods.description: Updates the TextView to display the current document counter using a string resource.
